# Average Vulkanized

**Average Vulkanized** is a lightweight performance-focused Minecraft modpack designed to improve FPS, reduce lag, and make the game run smoother while keeping the vanilla experience.

This modpack focuses on modern optimization mods and rendering improvements such as Vulkan-based rendering.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🚀 Improved FPS and smoother gameplay
- ⚡ Faster game loading times
- 🎮 Vanilla-friendly gameplay
- 🖥️ Optimized for low-end and mid-range PCs
- 🔧 Pre-configured performance settings

---

## 🔧 Included Optimization Mods

This modpack includes several well-known performance mods:

- [VulkanMod](https://modrinth.com/mod/vulkanmod)
- [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core)
- [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast)
- [ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix)

---

## 💻 Recommended Specs

- RAM: 3–4 GB allocated
- CPU: Any modern processor
- GPU: Supports Vulkan (recommended)

---

## 📌 Notes

- Compatible with most vanilla servers
- Designed mainly for performance and stability
- Ideal for players who want higher FPS without heavily modifying gameplay
